title: Support-product comparison with base change along the other leg
statement:
Use the global finite-field and finite coefficient conventions of [def-trf-coefficient-conventions], so $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$, $s=\operatorname{Spec}k$, $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}k$, and $A=A_{E,n}=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$ with $n\ge1$. Work with the geometric derived operations on $D^b_{ctf}(-,A)$, using the specified constructible exceptional adjunctions of [def-trf-admissibility]. All tensor products and pullbacks below are derived, with the signed symmetry of [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom].

Let $B,U,V$ be separated finite-type $k$-schemes, let $f:U\to B$, $g:V\to B$ be separated finite-type morphisms, and put $T=U\times_BV$ with projections $p:T\to U$, $q:T\to V$ and $t=fp=gq$. Write $A_W$ for the constant coefficient object on a scheme $W$, and use the constant-coefficient pullback identifications $Lp^*A_U\cong A_T\cong Lq^*A_V$. For compact-support base change in this Cartesian square write
$$
bc:Lg^*Rf_!A_U\xrightarrow{\sim}Rq_!Lp^*A_U,\qquad
bc':Lf^*Rg_!A_V\xrightarrow{\sim}Rp_!Lq^*A_V .
$$
Let
$$
\mu:Rt_!A_T\xrightarrow{\sim}Rf_!A_U\otimes Rg_!A_V
$$
be the support-product isomorphism with $f$ as outer direct image, built exactly as follows: the inverse of the composition isomorphism $Rf_!Rp_!\cong Rt_!$, then $A_T\cong Lq^*A_V$, then $Rf_!(bc'^{-1}):Rf_!Rp_!Lq^*A_V\to Rf_!Lf^*Rg_!A_V$, then insertion of the tensor unit $Lf^*Rg_!A_V\cong A_U\otimes Lf^*Rg_!A_V$ inside $Rf_!$, and finally the inverse of the projection transformation $\operatorname{PF}_{f,A_U,Rg_!A_V}:Rf_!A_U\otimes Rg_!A_V\to Rf_!(A_U\otimes Lf^*Rg_!A_V)$ of [def-sf-pf]. (This is the map $\mu$ of [def-trf-supported-pairing], Step 2, for $c=f$, $\bar d=g$, $e_C=p$, $e_D=q$.) For $N\in D^b_{ctf}(B,A)$ let
$$
\pi_N:N\otimes Rg_!A_V\xrightarrow{\sim}Rg_!Lg^*N
$$
be the signed symmetry $N\otimes Rg_!A_V\cong Rg_!A_V\otimes N$, followed by $\operatorname{PF}_{g,A_V,N}$ and the unit identification $A_V\otimes Lg^*N\cong Lg^*N$ inside $Rg_!$. Then
$$
\pi_{Rf_!A_U}\circ\mu=Rg_!(bc^{-1})\circ\bigl(Rt_!A_T\xrightarrow{\sim}Rg_!Rq_!A_T=Rg_!Rq_!Lp^*A_U\bigr),
$$
the unnamed arrow being the inverse of the composition isomorphism $Rg_!Rq_!\cong Rt_!$ followed by $A_T\cong Lp^*A_U$. All arrows are the specified compact-support composition, exchange, projection and unit transformations, with their signed tensor symmetries; no properness of $f$ or $g$ is assumed. Here $Rf_!A_U\in D^b_{ctf}(B,A)$ and $Rg_!A_V\in D^b_{ctf}(B,A)$, so every projection transformation is applied in its stated domain ([thm-sf-kunneth-relative] gives the same comparison maps in the relative Künneth construction).

proof.text: Put $F=Rf_!A_U$ and $G=Rg_!A_V$. The constant object $A_W$ is locally free of rank one in degree zero, hence bounded constructible with Tor interval $[0,0]$. By [thm-sf-ctf-stability] (i), (ii), (iv), all pullbacks, tensor products and compact-support images occurring below remain in $D^b_{ctf}$; in particular $F,G$ do. By [lem-sf-proetale-constructible-origin] (ii), these bounded constructible pro-etale objects admit bounded etale-origin witnesses, as required by the finite pro-etale domain in [prop-functor-package] (4). Use the concrete composition, compact-support exchange and projection isomorphisms of [prop-functor-package] (3)--(5). These are the specified maps on the finite constructible domain, with the constructible exceptional adjunction and biduality provided there and in [thm-sf-ctf-stability] (v), (vi); thus the geometric operations instantiate the finite-coefficient datum used in the relative-product statements. No properness or smoothness is needed for compact-support exchange. Write $\alpha_f:Rf_!Rp_!\cong Rt_!$ and $\alpha_g:Rg_!Rq_!\cong Rt_!$ for these composition comparisons.

source.place: Step 4, domains for the support-product comparison

proof.text: First record explicitly the tensor-unit cancellation needed for $p$ and $q$. For a chosen compactification $h=rj$, [def-exchange-projection] defines $\operatorname{PF}_{h,M,A}$ as $\pi_{r;j_!M,A}$ followed by $Rr_*$ applied to the open tensor comparison. The unit clause of [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-projection-mate-exact] says $\pi_{r;j_!M,A}=1_{Rr_*j_!M}$ after unit identifications. By [lem-sf-open-tensor-normalization], the open comparison $\gamma_{M,A}$ restricts to the identity; with $j^*j_!\cong1$, full faithfulness of $j_!$ therefore makes it the identity of $j_!M$ after unit identifications. Consequently the defining two factors give $\operatorname{PF}_{h,M,A}=1_{Rh_!M}$ under the canonical right-unit identifications. Apply this to $(h,M)=(p,A_T),(q,A_T)$. This is a two-factor substitution in the cited statements, not a new projection-formula theorem.

proof.text:
Let $\kappa_{f,g}:Rt_!A_T\to F\otimes G$ be the exact canonical composite of [thm-sf-kunneth-relative] for $(K,L)=(A_U,A_V)$, using $Lp^*A_U\otimes Lq^*A_V\cong A_T$. Consider also $\kappa_{g,f}:Rt_!A_T\to G\otimes F$, with its source transported along the canonical swap $U\times_BV\cong V\times_BU$. Expand the latter by that theorem's definition: its outer image is $Rf_!$, its inner projection is $p$, its exchange is $bc'$, and its outer projection transformation is $\operatorname{PF}_{f,A_U,G}$ of [def-sf-pf]. The inner inverse projection at $(A_T,A_U)$ cancels by step 2. The symmetry $Lp^*A_U\otimes Lq^*A_V\cong Lq^*A_V\otimes Lp^*A_U$ becomes the identity on $A_T$: both factors are tensor units in degree zero, and their unit multiplication is commutative. The pullback/unit identifications here agree by [lem-pur-derived-pullback-tensor-iso]. Thus, writing $\sigma_{G,F}:G\otimes F\to F\otimes G$ for the signed symmetry, the final target symmetry cancels to give
$$\sigma_{G,F}\kappa_{g,f}=\operatorname{PF}_{f,A_U,G}^{-1}\circ Rf_!(bc'^{-1})\circ\alpha_f^{-1}=\mu.$$
The unit insertion inside $Rf_!$ is understood exactly as in the statement of $\mu$.

source.place: Definition of the canonical composite, specialized to (g,f; A_V,A_U)

proof.text:
Expand $\kappa_{f,g}$ itself by [thm-sf-kunneth-relative]. In order its factors are $\alpha_g^{-1}$, the inner inverse projection for $q$ at $(A_T,A_V)$, $Rg_!(bc^{-1})$, the symmetry inside $Rg_!$, the inverse outer projection for $g$ at $(A_V,F)$, and the target symmetry. Step 2 cancels the inner projection. The symmetry inside $Rg_!$ only moves the unit $A_V$, so it is the canonical insertion of $A_V$ on the left. Therefore
$$\kappa_{f,g}=\pi_F^{-1}\circ Rg_!(bc^{-1})\circ\alpha_g^{-1},$$
where $A_T\cong Lp^*A_U$ is inserted after $\alpha_g^{-1}$. Indeed [def-sf-pf] gives the outer projection map, and the inverse of the statement's definition of $\pi_F$ is precisely the remaining inverse projection followed by the target symmetry. Every symmetry involving $F$ or $G$ is retained with its Koszul signs; neither compact-support image is assumed concentrated in degree zero.

source.place: Definition of the canonical composite, specialized to (f,g; A_U,A_V)

proof.text:
Apply [lem-sf-kunneth-coherence] (i) to $K=A_U$, $L=A_V$ on this Cartesian product. Its assertion concerns the canonical maps just expanded, and identifies
$$\kappa_{g,f}=\sigma_{F,G}\circ\kappa_{f,g}$$
after the external-product swap and the canonical source identification. The external-product swap on the two constant units was identified with the identity in step 3. Compose with $\sigma_{G,F}$; the symmetric-monoidal identity $\sigma_{G,F}\sigma_{F,G}=1$ gives $\sigma_{G,F}\kappa_{g,f}=\kappa_{f,g}$. Together with step 3, this says $\mu=\kappa_{f,g}$. This use of signed symmetry applies to arbitrary separated finite-type $f,g$, not just proper ones.

source.place: Clause (i), symmetry of the specified relative product

proof.text:
Substitute step 4 into $\mu=\kappa_{f,g}$ and compose on the left with $\pi_F$. The inverse projection and its projection cancel, yielding
$$\pi_{Rf_!A_U}\circ\mu=Rg_!(bc^{-1})\circ\alpha_g^{-1}.$$
The source unit identification in step 4 makes $\alpha_g^{-1}$ exactly the unnamed arrow $Rt_!A_T\to Rg_!Rq_!Lp^*A_U$ in the question. This is the required equality of specified maps, including their composition comparisons, unit maps and signed symmetries.

split_report.summary: Proved the exact other-leg support-product identity by expanding both canonical relative Kunneth composites at the constant units and applying the existing signed symmetry lemma. Wrote the compact-support tensor-unit cancellation from the defining proper/open factors. Statement unchanged; no new nodes or Mathlib leaves. All cited statements were read and backed by verbatim citation excerpts.
split_report.blueprint: Expands precisely Step 4 of lem-trf-trace-class-diagonal-pairing: the support-product map built with c as outer image agrees, after the Delta projection formula, with inverse base change along Delta. The proof uses general f,g in place of c,Delta; it does not alter the trace-class unit route.

tool_uses.why: Finite-stage preservation of the pullback, tensor, compact-support and duality domains needed to instantiate the existing relative-product statements; this does not replace a trace-class construction.
Supplies the concrete composition, arbitrary compact-support base change, projection and constructible-adjunction maps used by the support-product recipe.
Its tensor-unit clause identifies the proper factor of the chosen compact-support projection with the identity.
Its full faithfulness and restricted-identity clause identify the open factor of that same projection with the identity.
Its compatibility with signed commutativity and units identifies the constant-unit external-product swap with the source unit identification.
Clause (i) is the existing general signed symmetry of the canonical relative product; this is precisely the coherence invoked by the blueprint trace-pairing step.
